FN-TDUT59-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 27
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/22/2023
Senate Bill 27 as introduced will not directly affect state or local funding.
Page 1

FN-TDUT59-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 27
Committee: Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/22/2023
Senate Bill 27 as reported by the committee on Agriculture, Conservation, and Forestry would
exempt existing agricultural authorities from municipal ordinances and regulations unless the
board of an authority consents to any ordinances or regulations. This could increase the
administrative obligations of municipal governments by an undetermined amount for additional
regulation, subject to consent by an agriculture authority consenting to regulation.
Page 1

FN-TDUT59-4
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 27
Committee: Judiciary Sponsor: Senator Tim Melson
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 04/12/2023
Senate Bill 27 as reported by the Committee on Judiciary would exempt agricultural authorities
incorporated prior to the effective date of this bill from municipal ordinances and regulations,
unless the board of an authority consents to any such ordinances or regulations. This could
decrease receipts of municipalities by an undetermined amount dependent on the amount of
license fees or taxes that such agricultural authority would otherwise be subject to.
In addition, this bill would provide further for the types of construction and development
allowed by an agricultural authority.
Finally, this bill would expand the powers of agricultural authorities to allow such authority to
participate as a member of certain business organizations; to provides for loans, debt, and
capital financing; to establish or support subsidiaries or affiliates; and to enter into certain
contracts.
